我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过L-星门到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
texts.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for now we lack the necessary insight into the subspace mechanics that govern their use to lift the lockdown.
